messages:
alejandra: Postmortem follow-up for last night's cross-region surface spike. Root cause looks like resolver SERVFAIL bursts + LB sticky affinity replaying requests into a degraded path. Want short/long action split and owners so we can close postmortem items. :clipboard:

noah: I can take short-term mitigations: reduce sticky-affinity TTL for affected routes, blacklist resolver after 3 consecutive SERVFAILs for 60s, and bump probe frequency in the region. ETA 24h.

thomas: I'll own the long-term work: debounce routing weight changes (sliding window + min-change threshold), add deterministic fallback to prefer healthy egress region on resolver errors, and run a sticky-route config audit. ETA 3w.

sre-bot: alert: region-us-east-1 DNS SERVFAIL rate increased from 0.15% -> 5.4% at 2026-03-22T01:14Z. Route_flip_count=4 in 10m.

maria: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-incidents/3141592653/dns-pcap.pcap and probe logs at s3://redwood-incidents/3141592653/probes.log.

noah: opened infra PR for probe + blacklist change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/523. Will roll to canary tonight and post metrics.

alejandra: Action matrix (short | long | owner | ETA):
- "reduce affinity TTL (canary)" | "refactor affinity to consult resolver health" | noah/thomas | short: 24h, long: 3w
- "blacklist resolver after 3 SERVFAILs" | "routing debounce + min-change threshold" | noah/thomas | short: 24h, long: 2w
- "increase probe frequency (region canary)" | "sticky-route audit + dedicated pool plan" | noah/infra | short: 24-48h, long: 4w

thomas: recurring pattern note: saw similar resolver-triggered oscillation in 2025-10 and 2026-01. Recommend adding resolver health to the quarterly networking review agenda.

alejandra: I'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups board and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm deploys. If anything slips please ping me directly. :thumbsup:
